teaser.en: A forest climber from a genus infamous for poisoning cattle.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa wa msituni kutoka jenasi inayojulikana vibaya kwa kuwatia ng'ombe sumu.

summary.en: Mtobwe is Dichapetalum madagascariense, a climbing shrub of forest and thicket. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtobwe ni Dichapetalum madagascariense, kichaka kinachopanda cha misitu na vichaka-mwitu vizito. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.

about.en: Mtobwe is a scrambling or climbing shrub, sometimes a small tree, with alternate, smooth, elliptic leaves. Its small whitish flowers grow in clusters on short stalks that are joined to the leaf stalks, a peculiarity of the genus. The fruits are velvety yellow or orange and somewhat flattened.
about.sw: Mtobwe ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda, wakati mwingine mti mdogo, chenye majani yanayopishana, laini, yenye umbo la duaradufu. Maua yake madogo meupe hafifu huota katika vishada juu ya vikonyo vifupi vilivyoungana na vikonyo vya majani, jambo la kipekee la jenasi hii. Matunda ni ya manjano au rangi ya chungwa, yenye unyoya laini kama mahameli, na yamebapa kiasi.

where.en: It grows in forest, forest edges and riverine thicket across tropical Africa and Madagascar, including the coastal forests of Kenya.
where.sw: Huota misituni, pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka-mwitu vizito vya kando ya mito kote katika Afrika ya kitropiki na Madagaska, ikiwemo misitu ya pwani ya Kenya.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtobwe but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Dichapetalum madagascariense.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtobwe lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Dichapetalum madagascariense.

reason.en: Named alongside a Dichapetalum (Mtundukula) in Pakia
reason.sw: Umetajwa pamoja na Dichapetalum (Mtundukula) katika Pakia
Mtambaa mwingine wa misitu ya pwani
